title: GTA 6 Launch Trailer Likely Not Using PS5's New QSSR Upscaler
description: Gaming media analysis suggests that the GTA 6 launch trailer may not incorporate Sony's newly introduced QSSR upscaler for base PS5.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Will GTA 6 Utilize Sony's New QSSR Upscaler?

Sony recently introduced QSSR earlier this month, bringing a version of the PS5 Pro’s acclaimed PSSR upscaler to base PS5 hardware. Described as "quite extravagant," the technology has sparked widespread discussion across the gaming community, with many speculating whether high-profile upcoming titles will take advantage of it.

### Current State of QSSR Integration

At present, the QSSR technology is exclusively incorporated into first-party titles such as *Marvel’s Wolverine* and *Ghost of Yotei*. While Sony has confirmed that the technology will eventually be made available to third-party developers as well, the timing of its introduction led many to speculate that it might have been timed specifically to coincide with major industry releases like *GTA 6*.

However, gaming media analysis suggests that we are unlikely to see this specific upscaler utilized in the context of early promotional material or trailers for *GTA 6*. Given the complexity of Rockstar Games' proprietary RAGE engine and their independent development pipelines, adopting brand-new platform-specific upscaling tools for trailers is not guaranteed, and current discussions remain in the realm of speculation.

### Editor's Take

While Sony's rollout of QSSR to base PS5 hardware is an exciting step for console optimization, connecting it directly to *GTA 6*'s trailer technology is pure speculation at this point. As third-party developers gradually gain access to the tool, we will have to wait for official technical breakdowns to see how future open-world titles might leverage it.

## Looking Ahead at Third-Party Adoption

The introduction of QSSR to standard hardware opens up intriguing possibilities for developers aiming to maximize the performance of base PlayStation 5 consoles. Whether major upcoming multiplatform games will integrate these newer upscaling pipelines remains to be seen, but the continuous evolution of console graphics technology certainly keeps the development community on high alert.
